corrected_text: LiteRT-LM's SetCommonGpuOptions calls SetUseMetalArgumentBuffers(true) under __APPLE__, and every GPU executor calls it: the vision, audio and embedding executors directly, and the main LLM executor through CreateCompilationOptions (llm_executor_settings_utils.cc, GPU case). LiteRT's Metal delegate turns the option off only when argumentBuffersSupport == MTLArgumentBuffersTier1; with Apple's tables putting tier 2 argument buffers at Apple6 and later, the documented build binds kernel arguments through argument buffers for every GPU graph, the Gemma decoder included, on every Apple6 or newer GPU, including every iPhone Agello supports. The v0.18.0 source behind the shipped binary makes the same calls.
note: Final check after Run C (2026-10-15): the Run B correction was wrong about the decoder. 7b872544 llm_executor_settings_utils.cc:163 calls SetCommonGpuOptions; litert_compiled_model_executor_utils.cc:1032-1034 sets argument buffers under __APPLE__; v0.18.0 the same at :162 and :932. Agrees with X-CFG-009 and the MD-MTL-017 verifier note.
